name: modes-evil-ghostel
comment: evil-ghostel options, input modes and lifecycle. Covers evil-ghostel-initial-state (normal/emacs/insert), line mode under evil (normal-state dw cw x p A I edit buffer text, RET sends it; leaving line mode returns to PTY-routed editing), evil cursor shape vs DECSCUSR (main screen vs alt screen), evil-ghostel-mode off/on in a live buffer, a kept buffer after the shell exits, and two ghostel buffers at once. The shell's output is the oracle wherever input is edited. Every group starts from `eg-modes-main` (extra buffers killed, semi-char, insert state, fresh prompt) and has unique marker text, so one failure does not cascade. Driven on zsh.

eval: (defun eg-modes-main () (eg-modes-kill-extra) (switch-to-buffer "*ghostel*") (when (eq ghostel--input-mode (quote line)) (ghostel-semi-char-mode)) (when (memq ghostel--input-mode (quote (copy emacs))) (ghostel-readonly-exit)) (unless evil-ghostel-mode (evil-ghostel-mode 1)) (setq evil-ghostel--escape-mode (quote auto)) (evil-insert-state) (ghostel--send-string (string 3)))
(defun eg-modes-await (pred secs) (let ((n 0)) (while (and (not (funcall pred)) (< n (* 10 secs))) (accept-process-output nil 0.1) (setq n (1+ n))) (funcall pred)))
(defun eg-modes-line (tag want) (let ((got (buffer-substring-no-properties (line-beginning-position) (line-end-position)))) (unless (equal got want) (error "%s LINE %S want %S" tag got want))))
(defun eg-modes-grep (buf re) (with-current-buffer buf (save-excursion (goto-char (point-min)) (re-search-forward re nil t))))
